python3 - <<'PY'
import json,collections
cards=[json.loads(l) for l in open('items.jsonl')]
answers=[json.loads(l) for l in open('answers.jsonl')]
assert len(cards)==len(answers)==56
assert [r['card_id'] for r in answers]==[r['card_id'] for r in cards]
required={'card_id','letters','marks','crop_ok','errors','detail','owner_crop','where'}
for r in answers:
 assert required<=r.keys()
 assert r['letters'] in ['y','n','u'] and r['marks'] in ['y','n','na'] and r['crop_ok'] in ['y','n']
 assert set(r['owner_crop'])=={'one_central_line','text_ne_visible_line','other_complete_line','gt2_whole_neighbour_words','turned_or_clipped'}
 assert all(v in ['yes','no','uncertain'] for v in r['owner_crop'].values())
 assert all(set(w)=={'label','printed'} for w in r['where'])
print('Count and order verified:',len(answers))
for key in ['letters','marks','crop_ok']:
 print(key,dict(collections.Counter(r[key] for r in answers)))
print('Most common errors:',collections.Counter(e for r in answers for e in r['errors']).most_common(3))
